subject: general
question: In which form is data stored in a computer?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Binary.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Data stored in a compute in the form of **binary__**.
 
• A binary number is a number expressed only two symbols: typically &
